Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Love Marriages versus Arranged Marriages
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In many cultures such as in India, arranged marriages have long been a prevailing tradition, while in contemporary societies love marriages are increasingly favored. Some people believe that arranged marriages offer greater stability and family harmony, whereas others argue that love marriages ensure personal happiness and mutual emotional understanding."

Discuss both love marriages and arranged marriages, assess which one is better, and give your own personal opinion in an essay to an educated reader. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your view.
title: Task 2.1: Love Marriages versus Arranged Marriages
content:
Read the following statement:

"In many cultures such as in India, arranged marriages have long been a prevailing tradition, while in contemporary societies love marriages are increasingly favored. Some people believe that arranged marriages offer greater stability and family harmony, whereas others argue that love marriages ensure personal happiness and mutual emotional understanding."

Discuss both love marriages and arranged marriages, assess which one is better, and give your own personal opinion in an essay to an educated reader. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your view.

body1.example: For instance, my sister dated her husband for three years before marriage, so they understand each other's habits and solve daily arguments calmly.
body1.focus: View 1 (Preferred): Love marriages bring happiness & understanding (Câu #12)
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1] + Câu #12 (Hôn nhân tình yêu vs sắp đặt)
body1.point: Marrying someone out of genuine love and mutual understanding builds a happier home than following an arranged marriage forced by parents.

body2.example: For example, my neighbor married a stranger chosen by her parents, and she felt unhappy because they had nothing in common.
body2.focus: View 2: Arranged marriages offer family support but risk conflict (Câu #15)
body2.frame: Secondly, it allows that [ld2] + Câu #15 (Mâu thuẫn gia đình)
body2.point: Arranged marriages can bring financial stability and approval from both families, yet forcing traditional views on young couples often creates family conflicts.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I prefer love marriages because genuine love and mutual understanding help couples build a peaceful and happy family life.

intro.ld2: receive family support and shared cultural stability
